excerpt.zh: 这个帝国追求一种神圣的使命，即高尚身体与神圣的义体技术的融合。强化改造便是一种崇拜。
excerpt.en: This empire pursues a divine calling, the fusion of exalted body and holy cybernetics. Augmentation is worship.

texts.zh: 这个帝国追求一种神圣的使命，即高尚身体与神圣的义体技术的融合。强化改造便是一种崇拜。
texts.en: This empire pursues a divine calling, the fusion of exalted body and holy cybernetics. Augmentation is worship.

sections.zh:
我们崇高的使命是让[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]和机械的联合。我们的历史中充满了失败的尝试，然而在神圣意志的指引下，我们现在已经实现了与仪式植入体神圣共生的第一阶段。

我们才刚刚触及到我们无限的义体潜力。更先进的强化改造还在后头。

尽管如此，我们的信仰却存在分歧，不同的教派对神圣强化强化的最终目标争执不休。一旦我们回答了这个问题，圣洁的[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]与受祝技术的完美结合，将使我们完善当前首先的进化设计方案。

融合即神圣。强化物即崇拜。
sections.en:
Our sublime calling is the unification of [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine. Our history is replete with failed attempts, yet guided by the divine will, we have now achieved the first stage of a sacred symbiosis with our ritualistic implants.

We have only begun to touch on our boundless cybernetic potential. More advanced augmentations are yet to come.

Despite this, our faith stands divided, with competing creeds disputing the end goals of sacred augmentation. Once we answer this question, the perfect union of holy [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and blessed technology will allow us to improve on the limited designs of evolution.

To fuse is divine. Augmentation is worship.

sections.zh:
我们崇高的使命是让[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]和机械的统一。我们的人民生于虚空，早就清楚血肉是无法在群星之间生存的。我们的历史中充满了失败的尝试，然而在神圣意志的指引下，我们现在已经实现了与仪式植入体神圣共生的第一阶段。

我们才刚刚触及到我们无限的义体潜力。更先进的强化改造接踵而至。

尽管如此，我们的信仰却存在分歧，不同的教派对神圣强化的最终目标争执不休。一旦我们回答了这个问题，圣洁的[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]与受祝科技的完美结合，将使我们完善当前受限的进化设计方案。

融合即神圣。强化物即崇拜。
sections.en:
Our sublime calling is the unification of [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine. Born to the void, our people have long understood that flesh alone cannot endure the stars. Our history is replete with failed attempts, yet guided by the divine will, we have now achieved the first stage of a sacred symbiosis with our ritualistic implants.

We have only begun to touch on our boundless cybernetic potential. More advanced augmentations are yet to come.

Despite this, our faith stands divided, with competing creeds disputing the end goals of sacred augmentation. Once we answer this question, the perfect union of holy [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and blessed technology will allow us to improve on the limited designs of evolution - forging a form truly worthy of the endless void we call home.

To fuse is divine. Augmentation is worship.

texts.zh: 信徒们已为所有人揭示了义体技术的奥秘。然而，今天标志着我们旅程的开始，我们现在必须全心全意接纳神圣的融合。
texts.en: The faithful have unveiled the secrets of cybernetics for all. However, today marks the commencement of our journey, as we must now wholeheartedly embrace the divine fusion.

tooltips.zh: 我们必须采纳['tradition_category:tradition_cybernetics']传统树才能开启神圣融合。
tooltips.en: We must adopt the ['tradition_category:tradition_cybernetics'] tradition tree to start the divine fusion.

texts.zh:
在整个历史过进程，我们曾误导性地试图改良我们的[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]，却不幸地给众多神圣的承载体带来了无法修复的伤害，导致不同信条对神圣融合的解释产生冲突。

随着科技最终实现了完全强化改造，我们信仰中的神圣领袖——科技显圣师们，已召开了一次主教大会以确立我们教会的核心原则，将各种信条融合成一个统一的教义。
texts.en:
Throughout history, our misguided attempts to augment our [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] have irreparably lacerated numerous divine vessels, leading to conflicting interpretations of the divine fusion among different creeds.

As technology finally enables full augmentation, the holy leaders of our faith, the Technophants, have convened a Conclave. Its purpose is to establish the core principles of our church, merging the individual creeds into a unified dogma.

texts.zh:
我们的社会长期以来一直努力实现[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]和机械的完美结合，他们进行最终旅程的时间已经到来。
融合即神圣。强化物即崇拜。

下个月接受神圣植入体的人群：[From.GetCyberCreedPopsPerMonth]
texts.en:
Our society has long strived toward a perfect union of [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine and the time for them to take the ultimate journey has come.
To fuse is divine. Augmentation is worship.

Pops to receive holy implants next Month: [From.GetCyberCreedPopsPerMonth]

texts.zh:
随着神圣旅程的完成，我们的血肉之躯终于实现了机械和[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]的圣洁融合。对于信徒来说，最后一步是安装神圣的强化件。巨锤之使团要求我们的躯体成为神圣的工具。

我们的政府将全面采纳义体科学并进行重组，成立[Owner.GetGovernmentName]。这将与我们身体的融合契合一致。

融合即神圣。强化物即崇拜。
texts.en:
As we complete the divine journey, our vessels finally achieve the holy fusion of machine and [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]. The one final step for the faithful is the installation of holy augments. The Fellowship of the Hammer demands that our bodies become divine tools.

To align with the fusion of our bodies, our government will now fully embrace cybernetics and undergo a restructuring. The [Owner.GetGovernmentName] will be created.

To fuse is divine. Augmentation is worship.

texts.zh:
今日，我们以完全融合的姿态崛起，融合的不仅仅是身体和灵魂，还有我们的信仰。教条式信条不再统治；神圣的融合将是所有信徒个人的旅程。

我们的政府将全面采纳义体科学并进行重组，成立[Owner.GetGovernmentName]。这将与我们身体的融合契合一致。

融合即神圣。强化物即崇拜。
texts.en:
Today, we arise fully fused, not just in our bodies and souls but also in our faith. Dogmatic creeds no longer hold sway; divine fusion shall be a personal journey for all the faithful.

To align with the fusion of our bodies, our government will now fully embrace cybernetics and undergo a restructuring. The [Owner.GetGovernmentName] will be created.

To fuse is divine. Augmentation is worship.

texts.zh:
科技显圣主教团的形成曲折艰难，每个最重要的信条都要求在主教团中获得代表权。经过一番深思熟虑，巨锤之使团、钢铁之圣卫、思想之诗颂和劳力之结社受邀参加。

主教团现在怀着坚定的信念着手他们神圣的任务。他们的第一道法令要求普通民众增加什一税或履行强制性社区服务。
texts.en:
Forming the Conclave of Technophants was arduous, with each of the most important creeds demanding representation in the Conclave. After some deliberation, The Fellowship of the Hammer, The Templars of Steel, The Choir of the Mind, and The Commune of Toil were all invited.

The Conclave now approaches their divine task with fiery conviction. Their first decree demands increased tithes or mandated community service from the general population.

label.zh: 我们必须选择如何支持主教团。
label.en: We must choose how to support the Conclave.

tooltips.zh: 在这个局势中将有多个应对方案可用。
tooltips.en: More approach options will become available in the situation.

texts.zh:
科技显圣主教团的第二项法令呼吁正式确立信仰。长久以来，各种教派之间的差异在我们社会中造成了摩擦。

主要教派都提出了自己统一信仰的令人信服的理由，而更温和的声音则主张应采纳一条真正开放和包容的道路。
texts.en:
The second decree of the Conclave of Technophant is a call to formalize the faith. For too long, the differences between the various creeds have caused friction in our society.

The major creeds all make a compelling case for a unified faith, while more moderate voices argue for a truly open and inclusive path.

label.zh: 巨锤之使团能铸就一个更为开明的未来。
label.en: The Fellowship of the Hammer shall build a brighter future.

tooltips.zh:
教义将围绕巨锤之使团形成。所有与其他教派相关联的建筑都将被替换为寺庙。
该教派将会成为唯一的唯心主义派系。
非唯心主义思潮的派系将被允许生成。
tooltips.en:
The dogma will form around the The Fellowship of the Hammer. All buildings associated with the other Creeds will be replaced with Temples.
This creed will remain as the only Spiritualist Faction.
Factions belonging to Non-Spiritualist Ethics will be allowed to form.

label.en: The Templars of Steel will protect our [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed].

texts.zh:
选择[GetCyberCreed]后，其他教派的信众提出抗议。许多人认为主教团的所作所为背叛了“真正”的信仰。

到目前为止，抗议活动虽然如火如荼，但整体保持平和。只有时间才能告诉我们，这些火花是否会最终引发骚乱的火灾。

不管接下来会发生什么，我们必须决定其他教派的命运。有人呼吁明确地将他们开除教籍，将他们的教义定性为邪教，并以他们造成的骚乱为证据指控他们叛教。另一些人则认为，仁慈才是前进的道路，他们呼吁我们对我们信仰中失去方向的成员表现出宽容。
texts.en:
After choosing [GetCyberCreed], the other creeds protested. Many believe the Conclave has turned against the 'true' faith. 

So far, the protests have been heated but peaceful. Only time will tell whether these sparks will result in flames.

Whatever comes next, we must decide the fate of the other creeds. Some have called for outright ex-communication, labeling their dogma heresy, and the turmoil they have caused good evidence of their blasphemy. Others believe mercy is the way forward, asking us to show tolerance towards the misguided members of our faith.

texts.zh:
各教派的信众正在抗议，声称主教团拒绝了真信。

到目前为止，抗议活动虽然如火如荼，但整体保持平和。只有时间才能告诉我们，这些火花是否会最终引发骚乱的火灾。

不管接下来会发生什么，我们必须决定其他教派的命运。有人呼吁明确地将他们开除教籍，将他们的教义定性为邪教，并以他们造成的骚乱为证据指控他们叛教。另一些人则认为，仁慈才是前进的道路，他们呼吁我们对我们信仰中失去方向的成员表现出宽容。
texts.en:
The creeds are protesting, claiming that the Conclave has rejected the faith.

So far, the protests have been heated but peaceful. Only time will tell whether these sparks will result in flames.

Whatever comes next, we must decide the fate of the other creeds. Some have called for outright ex-communication, labeling their dogma heresy, and the turmoil they have caused good evidence of their blasphemy. Others believe mercy is the way forward, asking us to show tolerance towards the misguided members of our faith.

label.zh: 必须只有唯一的真信留存。
label.en: There can only be one faith.

tooltips.zh: 科技显圣师会镇压其他信条的信众，这会导致不满。
tooltips.en: The Technophants will suppress the other creeds, which may lead to unrest.

label.zh: 我们的信仰能够海纳百川。
label.en: Our faith has room for all.

tooltips.zh: 尽管我们树立了官方教义，但科技显圣师们对其他教派的习俗保持宽容态度。
tooltips.en: While there will be official dogma, the Technophants will tolerate the practices of other creeds.

texts.zh: 各殖民地上都爆发了信仰少数派群体的抗议，许多人指责我们偏离了神圣融合的正道。科技显圣师们则认为，这场动乱只是暂时的，因为我们大多数人仍支持统一的教义；这一切只是时间问题，假以时日更狂热的抗议者也会接受神圣的真理。
texts.en: Minority protests have erupted across our colonies, with many decrying what they view as our deviation from holy fusion. The Technophants believe the unrest is only temporary, as most of our people support the unified dogma, and it is simply a matter of time before the more zealous protesters accept the divine truth.

label.zh: 必须只有唯一的真信留存。
label.en: There will only be one faith.

tooltips.zh: 选择镇压其他信条的信众会导致不满。
tooltips.en: The choice to suppress competing creeds has led to some unrest.

texts.zh:
信奉统一教义已经在民众中传开，绝大多数各类教派的信众都抛弃了旧有的信仰和生活方式。

除了真正的狂热分子外，每个人都在为最后的转变准备他们的神圣[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]。
texts.en:
Dedication to unified dogma has spread among the people, with most practitioners of the various creeds having disavowed their old ways.

Everyone apart from the true fanatics are preparing their divine [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] for the final transformation.

label.zh: 我们神圣融合的真义终将胜利。
label.en: The truth of our divine fusion prevails.

tooltips.zh: 我们成功统合了信仰。
tooltips.en: We have successfully unified the faith.

texts.zh:
允许各种教派的教众自由表达是最和谐的选择：只有少数抗议声出现，只有最狂热的信仰成员尚且参与其中。

大多数信徒遵循我们的官方教义，我们准备集中精力于神圣的融合。
texts.en:
Allowing the various creeds freedom of expression was a most harmonious choice: only minor protests have been noted, with only the most zealous members of the creeds participating.

With the majority of the faithful following our official dogma, we are ready to focus on the divine fusion.

label.zh: 我们是一个不会分裂的信仰。

tooltips.zh: 对不同教条流派实行宽容态度会阻止不满的滋生。
tooltips.en: The tolerance granted to the differing creeds has prevented unrest.

texts.zh:
迁就极端主义的要求已经惹恼了大多数温和派。许多人认为，每个信条教派都有长期的宗教间暴力历史，让边缘信仰不受反对是错误的选择。

大多数人呼吁正式改革各信仰，实质性地消除它们原本应享有的所有独立性。
texts.en:
Giving in to hardline demands has upset the majority of moderates. Claiming every creed has a long history of interfaith violence, many believe that allowing fringe beliefs to go unopposed was the wrong choice.

The majority are calling for the creeds to be officially reformed, effectively removing any independence they would otherwise have.

tooltips.zh: 宽容其他教派已经使我们信仰中的温和派系不满，引起不满。
tooltips.en: The tolerance granted to the creeds has upset the more moderate factions of our faith, causing unrest.

tooltips.zh: 宽容其他教派已经使我们信仰中的温和派系不满，引起不满。
tooltips.en: The tolerance granted to the creeds has upset the more moderate factions of our faith, causing unrest.

texts.zh:
随着盛大的融合临近，我们回顾信仰中悠久的传统：时间的什一奉献。

回顾过往无数代先祖，社会中每位忠诚的成员都奉献出他们的一部分时间和精力给教会。就如神圣的融合一样，这种奉献有助于强化信仰的身体。

这些信徒应该如何最好地支持神圣强化改造呢？
texts.en:
As the grand fusion draws near, we look back to a long-standing tradition of the faith: The Tithe of Time.

For countless generations, every faithful member of society has given a portion of their time and energy to the church. Like divine fusion, this service act helps strengthen the body of the faith.

How shall the faithful best support the divine augmentation?

tooltips.zh: 每年，我们人群中的信徒会抽出一部分时间进行矿物开采。
tooltips.en: Each year, the faithful among our population will dedicate a portion of their time to mining.

tooltips.zh: 每年，我们人群中的信徒会抽出一部分时间从事农务。
tooltips.en: Each year, the faithful among our population will dedicate a portion of their time to farming.

tooltips.zh: 每年，我们人群中的信徒会抽出一部分时间在熔炉边工作。
tooltips.en: Each year, the faithful among our population will dedicate a portion of their time to work in the forges.

tooltips.zh: 每年，我们人群中的信徒会抽出一部分时间建造建筑、并在船坞中工作。
tooltips.en: Each year, the faithful among our population will dedicate a portion of their time to constructing buildings and working in shipyards.

tooltips.zh: 每年，我们人群中的信徒会抽出一部分时间去陆军服役。
tooltips.en: Each year, the faithful among our population will dedicate a portion of their time to military service.

tooltips.zh: 每年，我们人群中的信徒会抽出一部分时间去海军服役。
tooltips.en: Each year, the faithful among our population will dedicate a portion of their time to naval service.

tooltips.zh: 每年，我们人群中的信徒会抽出一部分时间研究神圣的义体科学。
tooltips.en: Each year, the faithful among our population will dedicate a portion of their time to researching divine cybernetics.

tooltips.zh: 每年，我们人群中的信徒会抽出一部分时间研究宇宙的奥妙。
tooltips.en: Each year, the faithful among our population will dedicate a portion of their time to researching the secrets of the universe.

tooltips.zh: 每年，我们人群中的信徒会抽出一部分时间生产必需品。
tooltips.en: Each year, the faithful among our population will dedicate a portion of their time to the production of necessities.

tooltips.zh: 每年，我们人群中的信徒会抽出一部分时间从事贸易。
tooltips.en: Each year, the faithful among our population will dedicate a portion of their time to trade.

tooltips.zh: 每年，我们人群中的信徒会抽出一部分时间手工打制精美的商品。
tooltips.en: Each year, the faithful among our population will dedicate a portion of their time crafting fine goods.

texts.zh:
神圣融合之时终于到来了。

我们应在自己的星球上建立神圣的强化改造中心，以开始这一进程。
texts.en:
The time for the divine fusion is finally upon us.

It is time for us to construct holy Augmentation Centers on our worlds, and the process can begin.

label.zh: 融合即神圣。强化物即崇拜。
label.en: To fuse is divine. Augmentation is worship.

tooltips.zh:
信徒们的全面义体强化改造已经开始。主教团的其他一切行动将暂停，直到神圣的融合完成。

行动要求：
建造一座强化改造中心以让融合主教团局势继续进行。
tooltips.en:
Full cybernetic augmentation has begun for the faithful. All other actions of the Conclave will halt until the divine fusion is complete.

Action required:
Build an Augmentation Center to resume the The Conclave of Fusion situation.

texts.zh:
钢铁之圣卫最近发起了一项禁止在历史和宗教记录中出现任何军事败绩的运动。

该教派声称，这些谬论打击军人士气、削弱公众支持。我们的历史学家驳斥了这种观点，并提醒我们，那些不学习历史的人注定要重蹈覆辙。

我们应该接受他们对历史更为积极的看法吗?
texts.en:
The Templars of Steel has recently begun a campaign to ban any examples of military defeats in our historical and faithful records.

The creed claims this information demoralizes those in military service and weakens public support. Our historians dismiss this notion and remind us that those who don't learn history are doomed to repeat it.

Should we accept their more positive view of our past?

label.zh: 想要获得胜利，我们必须有胜利者的思维。
label.en: To be victorious, we must think as victors.

tooltips.zh:
此举将取悦钢铁之圣卫教派
此举将激怒所有其他教派。
tooltips.en:
This will please the The Templars of Steel Creed
This will displease all other Creeds.

label.zh: 不接受。我们必须从失误中学习。
label.en: Unacceptable. We must learn from our mistakes.

tooltips.zh:
此举将激怒钢铁之圣卫教派
此举将取悦所有其他教派。
tooltips.en:
This will displease the The Templars of Steel Creed
This will please all other Creeds.

texts.zh:
最高主匠，也就是巨锤之使团的领导人，猝然离世。

尽管他们以直言不讳的行为和坚决的观点而闻名，但还是有一群信徒追随。使团要求为他们举行正式的国葬，而这通常是为我们最敬爱的领导人准备的。

不出所料，其他教派要求国家不应该参与这位讲话不知分寸的精神领袖的葬礼。

我们应该如何处理这个教派的请求?
texts.en:
The High Blacksmith, the head of the Fellowship of the Hammer, has died suddenly.

Despite being known for their outspoken behavior and decisive views, they had a cult following by members of the Creed. The Fellowship has requested for them to receive an official state funeral, an honor usually reserved for our most beloved leaders.

Unsurprisingly, the other Creeds demand that the state should have no part in the burial of this outspoken spiritual leader.

How should we address the demands of the Creeds?

tooltips.zh:
此举将取悦巨锤之使团教派
此举将激怒所有其他教派。
tooltips.en:
This will please the The Fellowship of the Hammer Creed
This will displease all other Creeds.

label.zh: 这不值得惹其他教派不高兴。
label.en: It is not worth upsetting the other creeds.

tooltips.zh:
此举将激怒巨锤之使团教派
此举将取悦所有其他教派。
tooltips.en:
This will displease the The Fellowship of the Hammer Creed
This will please all other Creeds.

texts.zh:
最近，有一支考古团队发现了一个古老的宗教遗址。它的存在仿佛是一个神话，迫使我们修改了宗教历史记录的一些部分。

最令人惊讶的事实是，许多出土的历史文物都带有劳力之结社的图样。这一信息证明，劳力之结社才是我们信仰的最初形式，而这是我们信仰中一个饱受争议的话题。

对这一发现的官方认可将取悦于劳力之结社，但选择性沉默则可以让其他的教派满意。
texts.en:
Recently, an archeological team discovered an ancient religious site. Its existence was considered a myth and has already forced us to revise some of our faith's historical records.

The most surprising fact is that many of the uncovered historical artifacts have clear Commune of Toil iconography. This information would prove that the Commune is the original interpretation of our religion, a heavily debated topic of our faith.

Officially acknowledging this revelation would please the Commune of Toil, but strategic silence would please the other creeds.

label.en: We must not fear the truth.

tooltips.zh:
此举将取悦劳力之结社教派
此举将激怒所有其他教派。
tooltips.en:
This will please the The Commune of Toil Creed
This will displease all other Creeds.

label.zh: 深埋于此必有其因，当它不存在吧。
label.en: This was buried for a reason, ignore it.

tooltips.zh:
此举将激怒劳力之结社教派
此举将取悦所有其他教派。
tooltips.en:
This will displease the The Commune of Toil Creed
This will please all other Creeds.

texts.zh:
我们发现[cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetName]与[GetCyberCreed]有很深的联系，并且涉嫌挪用资金并将项目重新分配到该教派的势力范围中。

当前政府能做出如此明目张胆的滥用职权，其他的教派对此勃然大怒，并要求[cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetName]立刻下台。

我们应该如何处置这位任性的领袖？
texts.en:
We have uncovered that [cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetName] has deep ties to [GetCyberCreed] and has both embezzled funds and reassigned projects towards the creed's sphere of influence.

The other creeds are furious that such a blatant abuse of power has happened on the current administration's watch and are demanding [cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetName] be removed from power immediately.

What should we do with this wayward leader?

tooltips.zh: [cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetName]被剥夺权力。
tooltips.en: [cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetName] is removed from power.

label.zh: [cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetSheHe]作出的杰出贡献已经将功赎罪了。
label.en: The good [cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetSheHe] [cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetHasHave] done outweighs this transgression.

texts.zh:
巨锤之使团的禧年朝圣即将开始，无数的朝圣者将从他们当地的锻造厂出发，前往首都的使团熔炉。

以往，这一盛事会造成无数的后勤问题，还经常因为使团与其他教派的信徒发生暴力冲突而告终。

其他教派和首都的居民都呼吁彻底禁止这种活动。
texts.en:
The jubilee pilgrimage of the Fellowship of the Hammer is about to begin, and countless practitioners will journey from their local forges to the Forge of the Fellowship in the capital.

Traditionally, this event has caused countless logistical issues and often ends in outbursts of violence as the Fellowship eventually clashes with practitioners of the other creeds.

There have been calls to end this practice from the other creeds and those living in the capital.

label.en: Disallow the pilgrimage once and for all.

tooltips.zh:
此举将激怒巨锤之使团教派
此举将取悦所有其他教派。
tooltips.en:
This will displease the The Fellowship of the Hammer Creed
This will please all other Creeds.

label.en: Freedom of religion is a right.

tooltips.zh:
此举将取悦巨锤之使团教派
此举将激怒所有其他教派。
tooltips.en:
This will please the The Fellowship of the Hammer Creed
This will displease all other Creeds.

texts.zh:
最近，思想之诗颂教团的领袖，大诗颂师，公开表达了对我们教会在研究资金方面缺乏投入的担忧。

人们认为这是该教团成员为争取更多资金而采取的一种策略。如果答应他们的要求，可能会被视为我们给予思想之诗颂特殊优待。

我们是否应改善科研资金的投入?
texts.en:
Recently, the Choir of the Mind's leader, the Grand Choirmaster, has been publicly outspoken about our faithful's lack of focus on research funding.

It is assumed this is a ploy to ensure more funding is going to members of their creed. Giving in to the demands could be viewed as us giving the Choir of the Mind preferential treatment.

Should we improve scientific funding?

label.zh: 让大诗颂师自娱自乐去吧，一会就自己没声了。
label.en: Let the Choirmaster sing until they lose their voice.

tooltips.zh:
此举将激怒思想之诗颂教派
此举将取悦所有其他教派。
tooltips.en:
This will displease the The Choir of the Mind Creed
This will please all other Creeds.

label.zh: 适度增加资金，直到这场风波过去。
label.en: Moderately improve funding until this blows over.

tooltips.zh:
此举将取悦思想之诗颂教派
此举将激怒所有其他教派。
tooltips.en:
This will please the The Choir of the Mind Creed
This will displease all other Creeds.

label.zh: 我们会大幅改善资金投入。

tooltips.zh:
此举将取悦思想之诗颂教派
此举将激怒所有其他教派。
tooltips.en:
This will please the The Choir of the Mind Creed
This will displease all other Creeds.

texts.zh:
奉向往繁星之圣灵的引导，我们信仰中许多不同的信条现在将对新的政府造成影响。

每个教派对信徒都有相当大的影响力，提倡将其成员提升到有影响力的位置，以满足他们独特的精神需求。

这些不同的压力是会让我们更接近神圣，还是会让我们陷入混乱，只有时间能告诉我们答案。
texts.en:
Guided by the divine towards the stars, various creeds within our faith now anticipate influence over the new government.

Each wields considerable sway over the faithful, advocating for the elevation of their members to influential positions and fulfilling their distinct spiritual needs.

Only time will reveal if these diverse pressures will bring us closer to the divine or plunge us into chaos.

tooltips.zh:
以下派系已组建：
—劳力之结社
—钢铁之圣卫
—思想之诗颂
—巨锤之使团
tooltips.en:
Factions Formed:
- The Commune of Toil
- The Templars of Steel
- The Choir of the Mind
- The Fellowship of the Hammer
